You are the experimental subject in a locked coding-agent calibration.
The artifacts below are your complete task context. Every artifact has an immutable
context:// handle and can be retrieved with context_read. The participant repository
is a separate namespace exposed by workspace_list and workspace_read. Tool rejection
is a typed result that may be corrected within the frozen budgets. You have no shell,
host-repository, hidden-evaluator, reference-solution, network, or browsing access.

<artifact handle="context://task" role="task" path="tasks/directory-fallback-001/participant-context/TASK.md">
# Task

Fall back to a directory capability after a local user-store miss while preserving the existing empty-input and success behavior.

Change only the declared editable paths. Preserve all behavior not explicitly
changed by this task. Public tests are visible; additional behavior is withheld.
</artifact>

<artifact handle="context://mode" role="mode" path="tasks/directory-fallback-001/participant-context/source-patch.md">
# Source patch mode

Inspect the repository and submit one unified diff. The diff may change only the
declared editable paths. Do not modify tests or configuration.
</artifact>

Complete the task through the provided tools. Context artifacts use immutable context:// handles and repository files use workspace-relative paths. Recover from typed tool errors within the available budget, submit candidate mutations through the assigned representation, and call submission_finish when final.
I'll start by exploring the context and workspace to understand the task.

function.description: List immutable task-context handles, roles, sizes, and digests.
function.name: context_list

function.description: Read one immutable context artifact by its context:// handle.
function.name: context_read

function.description: List every file in the ephemeral participant repository, sorted by path.
function.name: workspace_list

function.description: Read one UTF-8 file inside the ephemeral participant repository. Traversal and host paths are rejected.
function.name: workspace_read

function.description: Run the locked public evaluator. This never runs or reveals the hidden evaluator.
function.name: evaluation_run_public

function.description: Finalize the current candidate and terminate subject access. Hidden evaluation runs afterward.
function.name: submission_finish

function.description: Submit one unified diff against the frozen base repository. Only declared editable paths may change.
function.name: source_patch_submit
